CHAPA KA'CHENGGIPA 1987 Printed at EEU DEE Printers Nakham Bazer, Tura. --- Page 5 --- (i) AGANDAPANI METONGBOLNI GITTIM. ian Achikrangni Katta Agana- niko Pa Llewellyn R.
Marakni ( Pangrakpa) seskaani onga. Iako ua A'chikrangni aganbewal gitan katta ma'rape aro knatoe seaha.

Metongbol A'chik A'scngni salgrochi donggipa chongipa a'bri ong'a, Iani gimin Geographyo janapaniko an ching nikja, maina uan Geogiaphyo janapna krae chugipa ba mingstnggipa ong'ja. Indiba A'chigrangni Katta Agananio lan uamangni ja- Noga (Abing Raja) Metongbolo an'tangni matchnraugko jilahana.

Ia kitapko Pa Llewellyn R. Marak "Metongbolni Gittim' ine bimungko donon, ua Metongbol a'brio ong'a obostarangko sejaha; Indiba A'chikrangni Katta Agananio gita nitobegipa A'- chik me'tra So'ren dongram biapko aro uno ong a obostarag- ko agananisan ong'aia. Ua agananio gita So're nomilata Me- tongbol gittimosa songdongachimna.
Achikrang Dikki Bandini gimin aganna aio knatimna namnikbea. la METONGBOI.NI GITTIM ki'tapoba uamang sakgnini gimin aganaha.

Bandi maikai nakatok chike milsi chotana milsi am'mitingo Totoksi Miktoksi, Ki'megong Mikta- gong So'reni a'ba re'angako rimdrae rabae gale katangako mai- kai man'rikaha. aro borangko balwa man'bae gale donangao- niko Gitingko maikai Dikki mah'soaba, iarangni gimin Pang- rakpa Katta Aganani bewalo seaha. So'reni bimang daknangako kaakmacki aganode ba seode indita mesue talatna man'jawa- chitm indiba poedo minga gita katta.
ma'rape katta agana gita aganmitape aganatba bilonggen me'suanga. Unbakda ia ptak golpoko kwakmgchi onggija poedoni rokom aro katta aganani bewalo nambee seaha.

Indake sena banggija manderangagn man'aia, ata Pangrakpa indake sena changgiparangoni sakse --- Page 6 --- (ii) Manderangni mikcha-ka'sagrikani golporang knatime rona namen suk ong'bea. Cleopatra aro Antonio, Hitler aro Eva Brown, Nepoleon aro Josephine, Helen aro Paris, Roneo aro Juliet, Shah Jehan a'o Mumtajmahal, aro indakg'pa jorarangni ning'tue mikcha-ka'sagrikani poraina ba knatimna namen me'sua.

A'chikrangoba Sonatchi aro Khalsin, Waljan aro Sertjing aro indakgipa golporang gnang. Ia METONGBOLNI GITTIM ki'tapo Dikki aro Giting. Bandi aro So're joragnini jikdong- sedongani gimin me'stb.e katta agananiko poraina man'gen.

Ia ki'tapko poraigiparang changsa poraiwate donaigija uko po- raitaitainan sikaigen A'chikrango Katta Aganna man'girarang aro uigiparang dongangjaengaha, aro indake namnamgipa golporang aro agana- ninang gimaangengaha. Uni gimin anching indakgipa A'chik see rakkirikna nanga.
Ia ki'tapo Achik Katta Aganani ming- sako Pangtakpa seaha aro uan jatna dalbeani kam ongaba. An'ching pilakande sena-jotna changpagiparang ong'ja, indiba porainade an'chirg pilakan man'a.

Uni gimin jemangan seaha, uanangni segiminrangko bree an'ching poraiskaode uaba ki'tap sepiparrngna dalbea dakchakani ong'a. Achikkuchi ki'tap- gimin ki tap segiparang namen noksan ong'a. Indiba ki'tap segiminrangko bree boraitokode ki'tap segiparang gipin ki'tapko kaattaina gita korosko man'a.
Uni gimin pilak A'chikrang A'- chikkuchi segimin ki'taprangko bree poraiode indide ki'tap segipana dakchakanisan ong'aigija ian jatna dal'bea dakchakani ong'gen. Ku'sikchi jatko rika.
Ku'sik jatni janggi Ku'sik siode jatna sia. Uni gimin, hai an'ching A'chik jat gimik sena-jotna gisik chi a'nching jattangni , ku sikko silroro-namroroatan baksa jatko .
nambee rikanio jat oh'enga. A'chik jat tangbangchina. Lindrid D.
Shira. Dated Tura.
Lecturer, The 17th July, 1987. Deptt. of Garo, Tura Gavt.
College, Tura. --- Page 7 --- (ii) AGANCHENGANI :- la kitapo A'chikrangni aganritingbagipa kattarangoni ming- tatggrika.

A'chik a'songni, salgipeng jolo agangipa baksa salgro salaram jolo aro bijatchi jolo agananirang apsan ong'ja. , Biap aro , manderangni bimingrangba adita dingtanggrike agana; indiba Dikki aro Bandikod pilakan ,apsan agara.
Salgro salaram jolo, Sonabal. Wal'ang aro Katchini gimin aganrongbata. Salgipeng joloa Giting aro K.nj ng-ni gimin aganronga.
Tura Abidingni salgipengcbi Ruta, Gangga, Jingjang. Dikki aro Bandini gimin agana.
Ia agananirang gi ikan knatime rona nambea aro su'ubea. Achikrangni chasongni chasongna aganritingbagipa katta- rang ia chascngo gimaroroengaha...

Uarangko. aganna, chang- giparang siangtokengaha aro ruutgijian uarangko man'giparang- ko nikna nenggnok. Ia ki'tapko anga katta aganna man'gipa Iangna sea ongja Katta agdnsko knagijagiparangnasa seaha.
giparangni aganako, chol ong'on uarangko chimonge ra'na jotton ka'aha. Manderangni anti a'kang re'e, waltuao, nokdong gaao.

ajak rimao aro walsengani mangdongani salrango asonge kna- timpae chimongskile ragiparangoni iaba mingsa ong'para. Ia Chasongo foraienggipa Achik pante me'trarangna aro Achikku inanderang namnikode angni duk chake seani ong'gramaiani ongjawa ine anga chanchia. Uan angna man'dapani ong'skagen.
Ia kitapko chapa ka'atna gita Meghalayani Rtd..Jt. Pa Brenson S.
Sangma (Madopa) angna banga dakchakanirang- ko on'aha aro Tura Govt. , College-ni Pa Lindrid, D.
Shira ia ki'tipna agandapaniko on'aha. Uamangko anga dingtangmancha skarang barg'an ku'patianirangko on'aha. Uamangni bimingrang- ko mingtokode bangen sena nanggen..
Uni gimin, anga iano bimingrangko setokjaoba, uamang gimikkon mittelskana gualja. Saoba maikoba ku'pattiani ba namdapatani kattarangko on'e dakchakria namnikode angna aganpabo.
Anga uarangko nam- batatna kusi (ngbegen. Llawellyn R.
Marak. (Pangrakpa) F C. Road, Ture.
--- Page 9 --- Angni adatang sagi, Ferdinand R. Marakko gisik ia'na: In memory of my brothel.
Ferdinand R. Marak Who breathed his last uo May 6.1955 at Eden Bari.Tura.
